Today's X picks (2026-11-24): X itself was unreachable all day (403), so all posts were verified via Google search results. Main threads: Bitcoin breaks below $60,000 with $850M in 24h liquidations; Anthropic falls below its $83 IPO price, down 28% from its post-IPO high; GPT-6.2 Astra is the day's AI protagonist — OpenAI's strongest cybersecurity model and the engine Runway used inside ChatGPT for video creation.

AI practical / Agents:
1. Google DeepMind and Mencap launch the Easy Read Co-Creator Tool — Gemini turns complex health and finance documents into clear text and visuals, cutting work from weeks to minutes, with every version checked by human experts. https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2125201709852934598
2. FastCompany cites OpenAI's AI progress meter, saying it aims to encourage a slowdown — but comments "It won't work"; today's sharpest AI-governance discussion thread. https://x.com/FastCompany/status/2125191021428453573
3. OpenAI: GPT-6.2 Astra is its strongest cybersecurity model yet, scoring 22 points above GPT-6 Astra on ExploitBench Internal Port (Nov 18). https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2122750133133791592
4. OpenAI shares new data on how AI is changing research and accelerating it (Nov 21). https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2123191365983248653
5. Anthropic pledges part of its shares to work preventing catastrophic risk, held by the Long-Term Benefit Trust — background for today's IPO-price story (Oct 18). https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2111881963657412903

AI video / world models:
6. Runway creates video inside ChatGPT with GPT-6.2 Astra — Astra builds the Pantheon from historical drawings, Blender handles camera moves; a practical "model-generated scene + traditional camera work" workflow (UTC Nov 23 / Beijing Nov 24). https://x.com/runwayml/status/2124894381249585505

Finance & markets:
7. Anthropic falls below its $83 IPO price, down 28% from its post-IPO high. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125195749465977220
8. Bitcoin breaks below $60,000, with $850M in leveraged liquidations in 24 hours — today's key crypto number. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125064305372520946
9. Trump revealed news about Jensen Huang 29 minutes before it went public — a market information-timing flag (Google snippet truncated; only that line verified). https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125205423850418584
10. EU imposes temporary caps on hybrid-car imports from China and other regions during an ongoing trade probe. https://x.com/business/status/2125195258740793482
11. Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia — an Nvidia thread corroborating item 9 (headline only verified). https://x.com/business/status/2125149288502034512
items.detailZh:
X 本站全天无法直接访问（403），三场均受限；晚场改走 Google 搜索结果页逐条核查原帖链接、作者与摘要，未直接打开 x.com 核对全文。11 月 24 日主线有三条：比特币跌破 6 万美元、24 小时杠杆清算 8.5 亿美元，加密市场承压；Anthropic 跌破 IPO 价、较 IPO 后高点回落 28%，AI 明星股同样回调；GPT-6.2 Astra 成为当日 AI 主角——既是 OpenAI 最强网络安全模型，也被 Runway 拿来在 ChatGPT 内做视频创作。

一、AI 实用 / Agents
1. Google DeepMind 与 Mencap 推出 Easy Read Co-Creator Tool：用 Gemini 把健康、金融等复杂文件转为清晰文字与视觉内容，耗时从数周缩短到数分钟，且每版均经人工专家审核，是可直接落地的无障碍/实用 AI 案例。https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2125201709852934598
2. FastCompany 引用 OpenAI 发布的 AI progress meter：认为其旨在鼓励放缓，但评论 "It won't work"——今日关于 AI 进展与治理的最直接讨论线索。注意该帖作者为 FastCompany 而非 @OpenAI 本人。https://x.com/FastCompany/status/2125191021428453573
3. OpenAI 称 GPT-6.2 Astra 为迄今最强网络安全模型：在 ExploitBench Internal Port 上比 GPT-6 Astra 高 22 分；与今日 Runway 的 Astra 视频工作流帖子相互呼应。（2026-11-18）https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2122750133133791592
4. OpenAI 分享 AI 如何改变研究的新数据：AI 如何加速研究，是实用 AI 研究方向的最新数据帖。（2026-11-21）https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2123191365983248653
5. Anthropic 承诺部分股份用于防范灾难性风险：由 Long-Term Benefit Trust 持有，呼应其公益公司定位；是理解今日 Anthropic 股价跌破 IPO 价一帖的背景。（2026-10-18）https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2111881963657412903

二、AI 视频与世界模型
6. Runway 在 ChatGPT 内用 GPT-6.2 Astra 创作视频：在 ChatGPT 内用 GPT-6.2 Astra 使用 Runway 创作，Astra 根据历史图纸构建万神殿，Blender 处理运镜，展示了“模型生成场景 + 传统工具运镜”的实用视频工作流。（UTC 2026-11-23，北京时间 2026-11-24）https://x.com/runwayml/status/2124894381249585505

三、金融与市场
7. Anthropic 跌破 IPO 价 83 美元：较 IPO 后高点下跌 28%，是今日 AI 股回调的直接市场信号。https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125195749465977220
8. 比特币跌破 60,000 美元，24 小时杠杆清算 8.5 亿美元：是今日加密市场最关键的数字。https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125064305372520946
9. 特朗普在消息公开前 29 分钟透露有关黄仁勋的消息：提示市场信息时序问题。Google 搜索摘要内容被截断，仅核实到该句。https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2125205423850418584
10. 欧盟对中国及其他地区混合动力车进口实施临时上限：在持续贸易调查期间实施，是今日贸易/汽车市场新闻。https://x.com/business/status/2125195258740793482
11. 黄仁勋重返英伟达的报道：与第 9 条相互印证的英伟达线索。Google 搜索摘要仅核实到该标题句。https://x.com/business/status/2125149288502034512

说明：X 本站 2026-11-24 全天返回 403，本报告内容取自 Google 搜索结果页核对的原帖链接与摘要，未直接打开 x.com 核对全文；第 3、4、5 条分别为 11 月 18 日、21 日与 10 月 18 日原帖，其余 8 条为 11 月 24 日当日帖（第 6 条为 UTC 11 月 23 日、北京时间 11 月 24 日）。
